name: TrueWood Lite Black Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real black oak veneer on three sides, stapled to 5 mm black acoustic felt. The 118 in panel is 12.01 in wide end to end and 0.39 in thick.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: 8 three-side black-oak-veneered slats, each 27 mm (1.063 in) wide with a 10.5 mm (0.413 in) flat felt gap on a 37.5 mm (1.476 in) pitch; 5 mm slats over 5 mm black felt give 10 mm total depth, and this tile spans 300 x 600 mm (8 pitches). Near-black oak face tones are sampled from main.png, with procedural vertical oak grain and black felt informed by the gallery; the small softened edge profile is an approximation.
